verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an external authorization flow ('Autorizar y ajustar transacciones sin usar nuestro Core de crédito o Autorizador'), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes what each authorization event contains: merchant name, MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet or entry-mode fields, or partial-approval and incremental-auth flags. Merchant/category blocking rules and wallet tokenization are adjacent features, not auth-event payload context, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, every authorization event carries decision-grade context — merchant name and MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals
